Implemented the first complete migration slice.

- OpenUI now streams typed learning components alongside Markdown, with stable document IDs, lifecycle metadata, action routing, persistence, and legacy `<keating-*>` compatibility. The generated OpenUI grammar is injected into every live agent prompt. See [library.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/openui/library.tsx:438) and [AssistantChatPanel.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/AssistantChatPanel.tsx).
- Added Explanation, Callout, Question, Quiz, Flashcards, StudyPlan, ConceptMap, LearningImage, LearningAnimation, SharedNotes, and LearningSurface components.
- Introduced adaptive Media, Workspace, Improvement, and Voice capability bundles. Workspace and improvement behavior is consolidated behind five higher-level tools instead of exposing the full internal tool set. See [capabilities.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/capabilities.ts:1).
- Session hydration and interaction bookkeeping now use lifecycle hooks, eliminating mandatory startup tool calls. See [session-start-hooks.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/session-start-hooks.ts) and [lifecycle.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/lifecycle.ts).
- Added a separate `keating tui [prompt]` OpenTUI host over Pi RPC while preserving `keating shell` unchanged for full Pi extension compatibility. `/shell` switches from OpenTUI to classic Pi. See [opentui-host.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/src/tui/opentui-host.ts:1).
- Documented the architecture, tool-versus-hook boundary, migration constraints, and current OpenTUI sacrifices in [openui-opentui-architecture.md](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/openui-opentui-architecture.md:1). Implementation follows the supplied [OpenUI API](https://www.openui.com/docs/api-reference) and [OpenTUI documentation](https://opentui.com/docs/getting-started/).
- Regenerated the NodePod boot snapshot.

Verification passed:

- Root: 247 tests.
- Web: 387 tests.
- Root and web TypeScript checks.
- Full Vite, PWA, and Nitro production build.
- CLI help and separate-host command tests.
- `git diff --check`.

The remaining deliberate limitation is semantic terminal parity: OpenTUI currently streams conversation and supports basic RPC UI events, but rich OpenUI assessments and Pi-specific modal extension surfaces still switch users to the classic shell. Resumable and workspace OpenUI state also share a local persistence adapter until they move into the session and artifact stores respectively.
